Mem0 — three stores in parallel, fused o: Mem0——三种存储并行，检索时融合
extract facts write to all three: 抽取事实  同时写入全部三种存储
semantic similarity; top-k by cosine: 语义相似度；按余弦相似度取 top-k
best for: \"what did we discuss\": 最适合：「我们讨论了什么」
worst for: exact fact lookup: 最不适合：精确事实查找
periodic re-embed on the top-used subset: 对最常用子集定期重新做 embedding
fix: schedule re-embed; monitor recall@k: 对策：定时重新 embedding，并监控 recall@k
O(1) lookup on (user_id, type, entity): 按 (user_id, type, entity) O(1) 查找
best for: \"what's the user's phone\": 最适合：「用户的电话是什么」
worst for: semantic / fuzzy match: 最不适合：语义 / 模糊匹配
audit fact_type set quarterly: 每季度审计一次 fact_type 集合
every team invents a new fact_type: 每个团队都会发明新的 fact_type
fix: centralized type registry + review: 对策：集中式类型注册表 + 审核
typed edges; temporal validity: 带类型的边；时间有效性
worst for: unstructured prose: 最不适合：非结构化文本
conflict detector invalidates, not delet: 冲突检测器作废而非删除
temporal queries: valid-at-time subgraph: 时间查询：某时刻有效的子图
noisy extractor adds 50 edges per messag: 高噪声抽取器每条消息新增 50 条边
fix: cap edges per add; drop low-conf: 对策：限制每次新增的边数；丢弃低置信度边
fusion scoring score = w_rel * relevanc: 融合打分  score = w_rel * relevance + w_imp * importance + w_rec * recency

importance: tagged at write time, or lea: 重要性：写入时打标，或从使用情况学习
recency: exponential decay since last wr: 新鲜度：自上次写入或读取起指数衰减
voice agent recency heavy; compliance: 语音智能体  偏重新鲜度；合规场景  偏重重要性
retrieval agent relevance heavy; same e: 检索智能体  偏重相关性；同一抽取器，不同策略
scope: user / session / agent. every wri: 作用域：user / session / agent。每次写入选一个；检索查询跨作用域加权。
